title: I loved the @heatedrivalryparody musical SO MUCH #heatedrivalry #heat...
transcript: It's getting pretty heated off Broadway cause heated rivalry the unauthorized Musical parody is in New York, and it is honestly one of the funniest, most joyful, and surprisingly tender shows I've seen. This is clearly a musical made by people who deeply love and understand the source material. The theater just feels like stepping into the cottage. Heated rivalry, art everywhere, and you can order Kipp Smoothie at the bar. I saw the concert version of the show a few months back and loved it, but the fully staged production adds so much. It has a framing device that is genuinely brilliant and lets the musical stand on its own. It feels like a Celebration of fandom itself and makes the comedy hit even harder. And this cast. The ensemble is literally doing Olympic level work, playing dozens of characters with wild wigs, insane accent, crazy costumes, and perfect props. And then of course, our Shane and Illya. Jay Armstrong Johnson had me crying, laughing, and then also somehow emotional. His accent deserves a standing ovation. And of course, the Connor story curls. And then Jimin Moon brings so much warmth and vulnerability to Shane while also being so funny. This is an original musical. It has a full score. Composer Dylan Markarel is a mad genius. Release the cast album immediately! I feel like I'll be back to this cottage many times this summer because heated rivalry the unauthorized Musical Parody is currently playing through September. Oh god.
showTitle: Heated Rivalry: The Unauthorized Musical Parody
classificationReason: Creator explicitly states they saw both the concert version and the fully staged production ('I saw the concert version…but the fully staged production adds so much'), shares detailed first-hand opinions on casting, direction, framing device, and overall experience.
